parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of HistGradientBoostingClassifier not working with string targets when early stopping is turned on. The change is minimal and focused on the necessary fix.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining why the conversion to integer is necessary.
